messages:
deploy-bot: Promotion to release/2026-03-23 blocked: ci-staging artifact restore failed (checksum mismatch). Holding auto-promo. https://ci.internal/runs/12345

mike: which artifact? :eyes:

deploy-bot: redwood_core-1.4.2-py3-none-any.whl expected sha256=9f2a1c4b got=7d3b9f88
jane: paste tail of fetch logs

mike: logs ->
```
GET /cache/mirror/redwood_core-1.4.2.whl 200
stream copy failed: checksum mismatch
expected=9f2a1c4b... actual=7d3b9f88...
backend returned truncated object
```
sre-jen: sounds like mirror replication truncated an object. Options: 1) reupload mirror (fast) 2) pin to last-good digest and promote (safer during change window)
lucy: change window ends in 40m. prefer pin+promote then rebuild+reupload later.
jane: mike, fetch last-good digest from prod-mirror metadata?
mike: found it: s3://prod-mirror/redwood_core/1.4.2/sha256.txt -> 9f2a1c4b
sre-jen: if we pin, create incident and add rollback note. Also add an eval to check wheel contents against source.
mike: dry-run pin command:
```bash
deploybot promote --release release/2026-03-23 --artifact redwood_core==1.4.2 --digest 9f2a1c4b --force-pin --dry-run
```
jane: run dry-run, post output, then run without --dry-run if clean.
mike: dry-run ok. now running promote for real.
deploy-bot: Promote accepted: release pinned to digest 9f2a1c4b. Auto-promo resumed. Promo complete.
lucy: created incident INC-2026-114 (mirror truncation + uploader job). Added release note: "redwood_core 1.4.2 pinned to last-good digest due to cache restore checksum mismatch; rebuild scheduled."
jane: thanks all. mike, follow up with uploader job audit and list of recent uploads.
mike: will audit and post in #eng-infra.
sre-jen: marking thread resolved for release. Incident stays open for RCA.
